rdfs:label: Tel
rdfs:comment: Deprecated vCard Tel class (owl:deprecated in the W3C vCard ontology) — formerly the type of a structured telephone-number node.
notes: Deprecated upstream ("This class is deprecated. Use the hasTelephone object property."). Use `urn:solid:hasTelephone` directly to a `tel:` IRI, or, for typed numbers, `hasTelephone` -> a node typed `vcard:Cell`/`vcard:Voice`/`vcard:Fax` (and optionally `vcard:Home`/`vcard:Work`) carrying `vcard:value <tel:...>` (SolidOS) or `vcard:hasValue`.

examples.title: Use instead: a typed cell phone without the Tel class

history.note: Deprecated (vcard:Tel is owl:deprecated upstream); supersededBy hasTelephone, notes describe TelephoneType-typed nodes, Tel dropped from example @type.
